about.heading: About
body: My core strength is the backend: designing scalable APIs and services, and running them on AWS and Docker to build reliable, maintainable systems.

I started in web development and went deep on the backend; now I use AI-assisted development to expand across frontend and app, taking ideas all the way to shipped products. I pick up new tools fast, but apply them in proven, reliable ways.
